# Ledger schema and views

The ledger is one SQLite file with 11 tables and 5 views, as `spec/ledger.sql` states them. Each object's own page has its columns and the DDL. Read-only SQL (sql/transform, sql/filter, {query:} values, gtme query) is written against these. Prefer current_values and group_membership; the raw tables are for provenance. A sql/* step's result must carry identity_id; :run_id is bound when referenced.

## Views

The read surface. A `sql/*` step, a `{query:}` value, and `gtme query` are written against these first.

| Object | Columns | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| [`field_value_ranks`](/reference/ledger-schema/field_value_ranks) | id, identity_id, field, value, source, confidence, run_id, created_at, rank | field_values ranked per (identity, field): confidence DESC, newest first |
| [`current_fields`](/reference/ledger-schema/current_fields) | identity_id, field, value, source, confidence, run_id, created_at | rank-1 field_values — the current value per (identity, field), value still JSON-encoded |
| [`group_members`](/reference/ledger-schema/group_members) | group_id, identity_id | current membership as (group_id, identity_id) |
| [`current_values`](/reference/ledger-schema/current_values) | identity_id, field, value, source, confidence, run_id, created_at | current_fields with value unwrapped from JSON — the view to query for plain values |
| [`group_membership`](/reference/ledger-schema/group_membership) | group_name, group_id, identity_id | current membership keyed by group_name — the view to query for membership |

## Tables

The rows the views rank and join. Read them for provenance.

| Object | Columns | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| [`identities`](/reference/ledger-schema/identities) | id, entity_type, identity_key, created_at | one row per person/company; identity_key per SPEC §4 |
| [`field_values`](/reference/ledger-schema/field_values) | id, identity_id, field, value, source, confidence, run_id, referent, created_at | append-only facts: (identity_id, field, value JSON, source, confidence, run_id, created_at) |
| [`relations`](/reference/ledger-schema/relations) | from_id, relation, to_id, created_at | typed edges between identities, such as works_at (person → company) |
| [`runs`](/reference/ledger-schema/runs) | id, pipeline, config_json, started_at, finished_at, status, dry | one row per gtme run; config_json is the resolved pipeline |
| [`run_records`](/reference/ledger-schema/run_records) | run_id, identity_id, state, verdicts | a run's membership: state = last completed step id, verdicts = {step_id: pass\|fail} |
| [`step_events`](/reference/ledger-schema/step_events) | id, run_id, step_id, identity_id, event, detail, created_at | per-record trail: claimed\|done\|failed\|skipped_cache\|dry_run\|simulated, detail JSON |
| [`costs`](/reference/ledger-schema/costs) | id, run_id, step_id, identity_id, provider, amount_usd, basis, detail, created_at | spend per step/record; basis measured\|estimated (ADR-046: measured only when read back from vendor-reported cost metadata; a rate multiplied out is estimated) |
| [`deliveries`](/reference/ledger-schema/deliveries) | id, identity_id, target, scope, idempotency, run_id, created_at, status, sent_at, variables_hash | sends and handoffs, UNIQUE(target, scope, idempotency) — scope is the resolved idempotency_scope config value (ADR-044, '' = unscoped); status accepted\|confirmed\|contradicted\|sent; variables_hash drives redeliver: on_change (ADR-045) |
| [`groups`](/reference/ledger-schema/groups) | id, name, note, created_at, entity_type | named associations (ADR-021); entity_type is the members' type (ADR-054); character derived from events |
| [`group_events`](/reference/ledger-schema/group_events) | id, group_id, identity_id, event, detail, run_id, created_at | append-only added\|removed\|touched events per (group, identity) |
| [`payloads`](/reference/ledger-schema/payloads) | id, identity_id, adapter, run_id, content_type, body, created_at, expires_at | raw vendor responses, a purgeable cache tier (ADR-030) — never facts |

## Query shapes

The queries a `sql/*` step or a config value is usually one of, from `gtme help --agent`.

### cross-type membership gate (sql/filter)

Keep people whose company is in a group — membership by ledger facts, via relations.

```sql
SELECT r.from_id AS identity_id
FROM relations r
JOIN group_membership gm ON gm.identity_id = r.to_id AND gm.group_name = 'target-accounts'
WHERE r.relation = 'works_at'
```

### cross-record aggregate (sql/transform, company pipeline)

fan-in: count a company's known people into a field; declare provides: [acct.people_count].

```sql
SELECT r.to_id AS identity_id, count(*) AS "acct.people_count"
FROM relations r
WHERE r.relation = 'works_at'
GROUP BY r.to_id
```

### per-record derivation (sql/transform)

Derive one field from another; declare provides: [sql.shout].

```sql
SELECT identity_id, upper(value) AS "sql.shout"
FROM current_values WHERE field = 'full_name'
```

### Config value (one column → a list)

with: {domains: {query: ...}} — the list a source is parameterised by; zero rows fails plan.

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT v.value
FROM current_values v
JOIN group_membership gm ON gm.identity_id = v.identity_id AND gm.group_name = 'qualified'
WHERE v.field = 'company_domain'
```
